decisions: delivery items run one at a time in queue order, each on its own worker thread hsk-delivery (sequence items reuse export_sequence's worker and frame serving); admission per item just before it runs, so 4096 queued items never overload the 16-slot port

a cancel before the run cancels the item's reel handle at submit (reel never starts it, settles canceled); DeliveryCancel cancels a running item (reel publishes nothing; a PNG sequence names the frames written)
delivery item output paths are relative only (no root, drive, ':' or '..'); export_sequence keeps accepting absolute paths

PNG naming: output_path <stem>.png -> <stem>_<7 digits>.png; number = starting_number + span index, or with use_comp_frame_number the composition frame number (UNVERIFIED D5); codec_option = deflate effort; audio on refused output_audio_png

PNG samples written as rendered (no transfer conversion, no colour chunk), like the MOV path; premultiplied colour written into PNG RGBA when color=premultiplied (PNG defines straight alpha; AE behaviour UNVERIFIED D5)

output-module template mapping: reel exporter mov/mp4, VC-3 DNxHR LB/SQ/HQ/HQX or AV1 quantizer, PCM bits/float -> audio on; parameters/scope/targets/filters -> template_not_mapped; H.264/HEVC -> template_format_unsupported

composition items render in the static renderer's working space (linear sRGB, LinearLight) from DocumentTiles (copied planes, 1 GiB cap); audio layers: audio_id sha256:<hex> resolved on the bound sound port at the module rate
a user recipe id never equals a shipped preset id (export_recipe_exists; an entry that shadows one is export_recipes_invalid)
gaps_not_built: determinate progress of a delivery run is not exposed (delivery_run is synchronous; reel handles hold progress)
